objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with a lesion on his lower lip, taking into consideration his medical history and habits.
chief_complaint: Painless lesion on the lower lip

fragments.text: The patient reports a 3-month history of a painless lesion on his lower lip. He is a smoker with a one pack per day habit for the last 20 years and has worked as a fruit picker for the past 25 years.
Hypertension, Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. Current medications include captopril and metformin.
Smokes one pack of cigarettes daily for 20 years. Works outside as a fruit picker.
No other complaints or symptoms reported.

exam_leaves.text: Single ulcer near the vermillion border of the lower lip, without any obvious signs of healing. The ulcer is non-tender on palpation.

test_leaves.text: Dysplasia and keratin pearls, consistent with squamous cell carcinoma
